rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: The only verified evidence is a consensus guideline (ev-misev2023-quality-framework). That guideline supports the listed requirements but is not program data; therefore program compliance cannot be assessed from the supplied record (evidence confidence: not_assessed for program-specific readiness).
findings: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) defines consensus expectations: orthogonal characterization, separation from non-vesicular particles, transparent production reporting, validated intact-EV assays, and stability-indicating potency assays prior to product advancement.
The supplied evidence set contains only MISEV2023 guidance and no SGL-001 program-specific CMC, assay validation, stability, or batch comparability records.

Because program-specific documentation is missing, claims that SGL-001 has produced characterized MCB/WCBs, validated intact-EV release assays, stability-indicating potency assays linked to in vivo PD, or reproducible GMP-like batches are unsupported by the supplied evidence.

Advancing intranasal formulation or performing cross‑species delivery comparability without program-specific CMC and validated analytics constitutes a high process risk (interpretation of MISEV guidance in the absence of program records).
objections: Absence of program-specific documents in the supplied evidence file does not prove those documents or activities do not exist; treating missing submissions as program noncompliance is an unsupported inference.
Guidance statements in MISEV2023 recommend best practices but do not, by themselves, define program-specific acceptance criteria or prove nonconformance when program records are not provided.
Concluding program readiness (or lack thereof) requires review of program CMC/assay/scale‑up records; a single guideline source is insufficient to make program-specific determinations.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 sets expectations but the supplied record contains no program-specific CMC or validation reports to support the claim of characterized source-cell banks or scalable reproducible production.
claim_updates.statement: Current supplied evidence does not document an SGL-001 MCB/WCB, validated intact‑EV release assays, stability‑indicating potency assay, or reproducible GMP‑like batch production.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 requires orthogonal characterization and production transparency to interpret in vivo EV data; absence of program QC and manufacturing controls increases risk of misinterpreting biological differences.
claim_updates.statement: Advancing to cross‑species CNS delivery comparability without validated analytics and demonstrated lot comparability is high process risk.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 consensus explicitly recommends transparent, orthogonal characterization and appropriate controls; these are consensus requirements though not program-specific acceptance criteria.
claim_updates.statement: An orthogonal QC panel, validated intact‑EV assays, and stability‑indicating potency assays are required prerequisites before advancing EV formulations into cross‑species delivery testing.

decision_update.question: What evidence-linked identity and potency framework is needed before comparing SGL-001 lots or formulations?
decision_update.rationale: MISEV2023 supports the need for orthogonal characterization, validated intact‑EV assays, stability‑indicating potency assays, and reproducible manufacturing. No SGL-001 program-specific documentation was provided; request program records and re-evaluate before making an outcome determination.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: Absence of SGL-001 program documents in the submitted evidence should be treated as an evidence gap, not definitive proof that program activities were not performed.

hypothesis_update.rationale: MISEV2023 consensus supports these prerequisites; current supplied evidence lacks program-specific documentation needed to evaluate gate completion.
hypothesis_update.statement: A validated identity and potency framework (MCB/WCB characterization, validated orthogonal intact‑EV assays, stability‑indicating potency assay linked to in vivo PD, and reproducible GMP‑like manufacturing) is required before lot comparison or cross‑species biodistribution testing.
hypothesis_update.test_plan: Verify submission of listed program CMC and assay validation documents; confirm assay performance characteristics and batch comparability across ≥3 GMP‑like runs; demonstrate potency assay linkage to an in vivo PD endpoint.

proposed_changes.next_action: Collect and submit program-specific CMC and analytics documents: (1) MCB/WCB generation and characterization records; (2) validated intact‑EV assay reports (orthogonal QC panel) including LLOQ, specificity, accuracy/precision and validation/qualification reports; (3) stability study reports and a stability‑indicating potency assay development report with linkage data to an in vivo PD endpoint; (4) reports for ≥3 GMP‑like manufacturing runs with release data and batch comparability analyses; (5) formulation/device compatibility studies demonstrating intact‑EV recovery (ex vivo and, if available, in vivo). After submission, re-evaluate against hypothesis-sgl001-biodistribution-gate completion criteria.

risk_updates.mitigation: Obtain and review program CMC and assay validation documents; require ≥3 GMP‑like run comparability and validated orthogonal QC prior to advancement.
risk_updates.title: Insufficient identity/potency framework

risk_updates.description: Without validated analytics and demonstrated lot consistency, cross‑species biodistribution results may reflect product variability rather than true biological differences.

risk_updates.description: Insufficient product characterization complicates interpretation of preclinical efficacy and its generalizability across species and models.

risk_updates.title: Model transferability/effect generalizability

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported  available evidence (MISEV2023 consensus) identifies required elements (orthogonal characterization, separation from non-vesicular particles, transparent reporting) but does not document that SGL-001 has produced an MCB/WCB, validated intactEV release assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision), stabilityindicating potency assay, or reproducible GMP-like batches. Therefore the claim that current materials do not demonstrate characterized sourcecell MCB/WCB or scalable reproducible production sufficient to advance formulation is reasonable as an inference but is unsupported by program-specific evidence in the supplied record.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific CMC documentation (MCB/WCB creation records), validated assay reports (intactEV release assays, LLOQ, specificity, precision), and scaleup/GMPlike batch production and comparability data are missing.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Supported (process risk inference)  MISEV2023 documents that separation from nonvesicular particles, orthogonal characterization, and detailed production reporting are necessary to interpret invivo EV data reliably. In the absence of provided manufacturing controls (MCB/WCB, validated QC), advancing to crossspecies comparability would be high risk. However, this conclusion is based on guideline expectations and absence of supplied program CMC evidence rather than direct program records.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: No GMPlike run records, nor ex vivo/in vivo recovery data demonstrating formulation/device compatibility with intactEV recovery were supplied.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Supported (guideline-backed requirement)  MISEV2023 explicitly recommends transparent, orthogonal characterization and appropriate controls; therefore, the statement that an orthogonal QC panel, validated intactEV assays, and stabilityindicating, mechanismlinked potency assays are required before formulation advancement is supported as a consensus requirement. The supplied record contains MISEV guidance but lacks program-specific assay validation or stability/potency linkage data.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Validated reports for orthogonal QC assays, stabilityindicating potency assays, and documentation demonstrating correlation between potency assay and in vivo PD are absent.

verification_objections: That SGL‑001 has produced a characterized MCB/WCB (master/working cell bank) — no program MCB/WCB records were supplied in the provided evidence.
That SGL‑001 has validated intact‑EV release assays with documented LLOQ, specificity, and precision — no assay validation reports were supplied.
That SGL‑001 has a stability‑indicating potency assay that is linked to an in vivo PD measure — no stability or potency linkage reports were supplied.

That SGL‑001 has produced ≥3 GMP‑like manufacturing runs with release and batch comparability data demonstrating reproducible production — no batch manufacturing/run reports or comparability data were supplied.
That formulation/device compatibility has been demonstrated for intact‑EV recovery ex vivo or in vivo for SGL‑001 — no formulation/device compatibility study reports were supplied.
